Privacy Policy — StringScanner

Last updated: October 14, 2026

StringScanner (“the App”) is a macOS developer utility that scans local project folders you select for string literals and localization gaps.

Data collection

The App does not collect, transmit, sell, or share personal data. Scanning and export happen on your Mac. The App Store build does not require a network connection for core features.

Local files

The App only reads folders you explicitly grant via the system file picker (security-scoped access). Export files are written only to locations you choose.

隐私政策 — StringScanner

更新日期：2026年10月14日

StringScanner（「本应用」）是一款 macOS 开发者工具，用于扫描您选择的本地工程目录中的字符串字面量与本地化缺口。

数据收集

本应用不收集、传输、出售或共享个人数据。扫描与导出均在您的 Mac 本地完成。App Store 版本的核心功能无需联网。

本地文件

本应用仅读取您通过系统文件选择器明确授权的文件夹，导出文件仅写入您指定的位置。
